maya: Hey team, running through the JS SDK quickstart for edge runtimes (Cloudflare/Bun/Netlify). Hitting runtime errors: Bun complains about `export * from` in our CJS artifacts, Cloudflare worker throws `ReferenceError: require is not defined`. Any pragmatic packaging patterns?

owen: We hit this before. Short answer: explicit exports map + an edge subpath. Example: `"exports": {"import": "./dist/index.mjs","require": "./dist/index.cjs","./edge": "./dist/worker.mjs"}`. Then samples can import `redwood-sdk/edge`.

maya: That fixed the worker import. Thanks. Now typings: our `client.generate` has two overloads (string prompt vs typed input). Without a generic users get `any` and the quickstart shows `as any` in a few places. Need safer defaults.

sam: Overloads are brittle. TS picks the non-generic overload when inference is ambiguous. Recommend switching to one generic signature: `generate<T = unknown>(opts: GenOpts<T>): Promise<GenResp<T>>` with a discriminant like `mode: 'text' | 'json'`. Defaulting to `unknown` prevents accidental `any`.

nina: Agreed. Also add a very small sample showing how to opt into types: `const resp = await client.generate<MyType>({mode:'json', input: {...}});` and mention zod/validator for runtime checks.

maya: Build trouble: when I add generic in the sample, esbuild errors with a `this` transform stacktrace. tsconfig for samples is currently: `{"compilerOptions":{"module":"ESNext","target":"ES2022","isolatedModules":true,"declaration":true,"preserveValueImports":true}}`.

owen: Two notes: 1) `declaration:true` + `isolatedModules:true` breaks tsc emit for d.ts in many setups. For sample bundling with esbuild set `declaration:false` or use a sample tsconfig that overrides it. 2) `preserveValueImports:true` can elide side-effect imports and confuse some bundlersset it false for sample builds.

sam: For the typings change, we should implement `GenOpts<T>` as a discriminated union: `{mode:'text'; input:string} | {mode:'json'; input:T}` so inference flows when user passes a generic. Also add `T = unknown` default.

ci-bot: ci: quickstart-samples build (node 18) failed on bun matrix; logs: https://ci/edge/0001 - Bun job error `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for deep export.

nina: For Bun, we published a tiny `compat` entry in the past: `redwood-sdk/compat` that simply re-exports the ESM build with a plain `index.mjs` (no exports map). It's not pretty but helps early adopters. Maybe add a note in README.

maya: Action items: 1) add exports map + `./edge` entry, 2) change overloads -> single generic + discriminant union, default generic to `unknown`, 3) add `tsconfig.sample.json` (module: ESNext, target: ES2020, isolatedModules: true, declaration: false, preserveValueImports: false) for esbuild, 4) add tiny `compat` re-export for Bun users and a README snippet. I'll open a PR labeled `devex` with two commits (packaging + typings/samples).

owen: Please tag @sam for the typing review and include a changelog note explaining the `unknown` default to avoid surprises.

sam: Happy to review. Also add a short test job to CI (opt-in) for Bun/Netlify/Cloudflare to catch regressions.

maya: Thanks all 44d
